title: System preferences: compare with defaults
intro: Read-only. Stored database values are compared with the installation defaults in the local Koha files. Differences are not necessarily errors.
comparison_error: Comparison unavailable: the local sysprefs.sql is missing, unreadable or uses an unsupported format, or system preferences could not be read. No settings were changed. Please check the installation and file access.
version_mismatch: Code and database versions do not match. Defaults belong to the installed code files, not necessarily to the current database version.
baseline_help: These are base defaults for a fresh installation, not this library's original configuration. Local changes to the source file are included. Language/MARC choices, installer customizations and runtime values may produce expected differences. Version is displayed separately.
override_help: Overrides show only OVERRIDE_SYSPREF values visible to this staff web process; OPAC, SIP and other processes may differ. NULL, empty text, spaces and line breaks are compared exactly.
secrets_help: Recognized credentials are masked, including in the HTML source. Detection is conservative but incomplete: free text may contain other confidential information. Review this page before sharing it.
no_javascript: Without JavaScript all preferences are displayed; filters are unavailable.
caption: Stored values and version defaults
